In this video, I travel by local train to Gehlaur village in Bihar to visit the legendary Dashrath Manjhi Mountain, the place where one ordinary man created an extraordinary piece of history.
Dashrath Manjhi, popularly known as the Mountain Man of India, spent 22 years carving a path through a massive mountain using nothing but a hammer and chisel. After losing his wife because she could not reach medical help in time, he made it his mission to cut through the mountain and create a shorter route for his village.
